rows.text: The President's Secretariat communique of 22 May 2004 states that the President of India has appointed Dr. Manmohan Singh as the Prime Minister of India, and lists the members of the Council of Ministers appointed on his advice.

The same communique states that the President administered the oaths of office and secrecy to 'the above members of the Council of Ministers' at a ceremony in Rashtrapati Bhavan 'today' (22 May 2004).
